data.description: The figure is a BHA (Bottom Hole Assembly) graphical report for well ID Forge 56-32, located in the UTAHFORGE field. The BHA consists of various components including HWDP (Heavy Weight Drill Pipe), JAR (Joint Assembly Ring), DC (Drill Collar), MONEL, STAB, OTHER, MMTR (Measurement While Drilling Tool), and a BIT. Each component is detailed with its length in feet, internal diameter in inches, top thread type, serial number, and the distance from the top to the bit.
